children: Morris John Christopher, an officer serving as EVP & CTO, sold 15,465 ordinary shares at $772.1512 per share for a total reported sale amount of $11,941,318 and directly owns 31,132 ordinary shares following the transaction.
William D. Mosley, a director and CEO, sold ordinary shares at $772.1432 per share for a total reported sale amount of $75,584,325 and directly owns 378,108 ordinary shares following the transaction.

Romano Gianluca, an officer serving as EVP & CFO, sold 49,983 ordinary shares at $772.1573 per share for a total reported sale amount of $38,594,738 and directly owns 70,756 ordinary shares following the transaction.
